company.shortDescription: OneSignal is a customer messaging and engagement platform that allows businesses to create meaningful customer connections.
company.description:
OneSignal is a customer messaging and engagement platform that allows businesses to provide a seamless messaging experience to create meaningful customer connections. OneSignal's multi-channel platform enables businesses to deliver over 8 billion messages daily. OneSignal is designed to scale with businesses and deliver messages more quickly.

The platform leverages machine learning to send communications at the optimal time by creating personalized messages and sending them to the right audiences by comparing performance, enabling clients to deliver engaging mobile and web push messages across all platforms.
